parsed.title: Discussion on AI tools in job search and software development

topics.title: AI for job search and resume automation

claims.text: The user plans to set up a cloud system to automate job search, resume PDF generation, and cover letter writing.
Having AI‑related skills (Cursor, Claude Code, LLM, RAG, Embeddings) is now essential for job seekers to avoid being filtered out by recruiters.
The perception of AI startups shifted from being niche in 2024 to mainstream in 2026.
The user expects recruiters as a profession to become obsolete.
Since 2025, AI tools have become good enough to noticeably speed up development.
The user describes using GPT to generate JOIN queries, reducing routine work and accelerating development.
Generated code can be problematic, leading to inefficient queries and security risks.
An AI‑generated 450‑line raw SQL query fetched all user data, causing potential security and performance issues.
Team members sometimes reject AI‑generated features because they are unsafe or non‑functional.
AI cannot replace deep contextual understanding accumulated by developers over time.
Without proper logs, AI may fail to help diagnose issues.
